think the many one-star reviews already make it clear how poorly this surgery is run. Unfortunately, my own experience over the past two years has been just as disappointing.

The reception staff are consistently rude and dismissive, both in person and over the phone. Patients are forced to use the Anima online system rather than being allowed to make straightforward requests by phone. Even then, responses often take days — or never come at all. My most recent Anima request went unanswered for over a week. When I eventually called to chase it, the receptionist was rude, gave no meaningful update, and simply told me to “wait for a doctor to respond.”

I’ve raised multiple complaints and repeatedly requested a call from the practice manager, Haley S, but despite several attempts, she has never contacted me.

When I developed significant breathing problems in late 2024, the handling of my care was appalling. After several appointments and conflicting advice, I was told an urgent ENT referral had been made on a two-week wait. The letter I later received showed a 19-week wait instead. I called the practice multiple times, was promised the referral would be expedited, and was even told I’d receive an urgent GP call — which didn’t happen until much later, only for the GP to deny what I’d previously been told. I eventually had to contact the hospital myself to get the referral treated as urgent (which advised I needed urgent corrective nasal surgery).

To make matters worse, a third-party rehabilitation provider I’ve been dealing with following a major accident contacted the surgery for information. I was informed the practice had been completely unresponsive to their repeated requests. I’m now facing the same issue with my solicitor, whose information requests are also being ignored.

Overall, my experience with this surgery has been defined by poor communication, false assurances, and a complete lack of accountability. I’ve lost all confidence in their ability to manage patient care. Absolutely disgraceful service.",null,[0,176]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pReFFYWkpXR3RVVUc4MVVtdEVaRlEyWkRCemNHYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xa645758cbc33feca!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjQxQXZJWGtUUG81UmtEZFQ2ZDBzcGc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pReFFYWkpXR3RVVUc4MVVtdEVaRlEyWkRCemNHYxAB&t=1&-M7yMdUWmKgswZDQ1dUVvT01ScQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjkrraorq-TAxU7LmMBHdODIPoQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjkrraorq-TAxU7LmMBHdODIPoQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWRKVFVJek5GOWZSV2hFUzNwRVRtZGlUVVF4YlRRdFVHaEJkMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSV1VOYVdXZDNTR1puV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEMG9fRWFBEAE",["0x0:0xa645758cbc33feca",null,1711455477915315,1760953711006026,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102024563530640303936/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Mike Hughes","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWX4jjajHycSq96D0K3RH7zsc6JCHPg6bFiZxQlA3BOcgGbTFE6=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102024563530640303936?hl=en"],"102024563530640303936",null,29,9,null,[1,4,1],10,["Local Guide · 29 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjkrraorq-TAxU7LmMBHdODIPoQ7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"Edited 5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["One star too many.
